name: inputs/animated-select
title: Animated select
description: A select whose options unroll from the trigger.

files.content:
export { AnimatedSelect } from './AnimatedSelect';
export type { AnimatedSelectProps, SelectOption } from './AnimatedSelect';

keyboard.action: Open the list on the selected option; when open, move the highlight (stops at the ends).
Open the list, or choose the highlighted option and close.
Highlight the first or last option (opening the list if needed).
Choose the highlighted option, close and move on.
Highlight the next option starting with those letters.

notes: Follows the WAI-ARIA select-only combobox pattern: a `combobox` with `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, and a `listbox` of `option`s with `aria-selected`.
Focus stays on the combobox; the highlighted option is exposed with `aria-activedescendant`.
The label, hint and error are wired with `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`; errors set `aria-invalid`.
The selected option is marked with a tick and bold text as well as by state.
Options are at least 44 px tall.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The list appears in place without unrolling, and options appear together.
